nodes.summary: A convex polytope in $\mathbb{R}^n$ is given by its vertex set: a finite nonempty set $V \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ that equals the set of extreme points of its convex hull $\operatorname{conv}(V)$. The polytope itself is the convex set $\operatorname{conv}(V)$.
nodes.title: Convex polytope

nodes.summary: The dimension of a convex polytope $P \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ is its affine dimension: the dimension of the real vector space spanned by the differences $x - y$ of points $x, y \in P$.
nodes.title: Dimension of a convex polytope

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the real Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$: $n$-tuples of reals with the standard inner product and norm.
nodes.title: Ambient Euclidean space of the Platonic classification

nodes.summary: For a subset $F \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$, its affine dimension is the dimension of the real vector space spanned by the differences $x - y$ with $x, y \in F$. The empty set and every single point get dimension $0$.
nodes.title: Affine dimension of a set

nodes.summary: A flag of a convex polytope $P \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ is a sequence $F_0, F_1, \dots, F_{n-1}$ of faces of $P$ such that each $F_k$ has affine dimension $k$ and $F_i \subsetneq F_j$ whenever $i < j$.
nodes.title: Flag of a convex polytope

nodes.summary: A face of a convex polytope $P \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ is a nonempty set of the form $\{x \in P : \ell(y) \le \ell(x) \text{ for all } y \in P\}$ for some linear functional $\ell$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$, that is, the set of points where $\ell$ attains its maximum over $P$. Taking $\ell = 0$ shows that $P$ itself is a face.
nodes.title: Face of a convex polytope

nodes.summary: A convex polytope $P \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ is full-dimensional if its dimension equals $n$.
nodes.title: Full-dimensional convex polytope

nodes.summary: A convex polytope $P \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ is regular (Platonic) if it is full-dimensional and for any two flags $(F_0, \dots, F_{n-1})$ and $(G_0, \dots, G_{n-1})$ of $P$ there is an affine isometry $\varphi$ of $\mathbb{R}^n$ with $\varphi(P) = P$ and $\varphi(F_k) = G_k$ for every $k < n$.
nodes.title: Regular convex polytope

nodes.summary: An affine isometry $\varphi$ of $\mathbb{R}^n$ is a symmetry of a convex polytope $P \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ if $\varphi(P) = P$.
nodes.title: Symmetry of a convex polytope

nodes.summary: The rigid motions of $\mathbb{R}^n$ are the affine isometric bijections $\mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}^n$.
nodes.title: Rigid motions

nodes.summary: For $d \in \mathbb{N}$ let $p_d \in \mathbb{N} \cup \{\infty\}$ be the number of regular convex polytopes in $\mathbb{R}^d$ up to similarity. Then $p_2 = \infty$, $p_3 = 5$, $p_4 = 6$, and $p_d = 3$ for every $d \ge 5$.
nodes.title: Classification of the Platonic polytopes

nodes.summary: For $d \in \mathbb{N}$, $p_d \in \mathbb{N} \cup \{\infty\}$ is the number of similarity classes of regular convex polytopes in $\mathbb{R}^d$, with $p_d = \infty$ when there are infinitely many classes.
nodes.title: Number of Platonic polytopes

nodes.summary: Let $V, E, F, p, q$ be natural numbers with $V, E, F > 0$ and $p, q \ge 3$, and let $l > 0$ and $d > 0$ be real numbers. Let $x_0, \dots, x_{V-1}$ be points of the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^3$, let $K$ be their convex hull and let $\partial K$ be its topological boundary. Let each edge $e < E$ be an ordered pair $(a_e, b_e)$ of point indices, with segment $[x_{a_e}, x_{b_e}]$, and let each face $f < F$ be a list…
nodes.title: Classification of the Platonic solids

nodes.summary: For $d \in \mathbb{N}$, this is the set of regular (Platonic) convex polytopes in $\mathbb{R}^d$: the convex polytopes in $\mathbb{R}^d$ that are full-dimensional and whose symmetry group acts transitively on their flags.
nodes.title: Regular polytopes

nodes.summary: For regular convex polytopes $P$ and $Q$ in $\mathbb{R}^d$, $P$ is related to $Q$ when they are similar as convex polytopes, that is, when there are a real number $a > 0$ and an affine isometry $\varphi$ of $\mathbb{R}^d$ such that the underlying set of $Q$ is $\{a\,\varphi(x) : x \in P\}$.
nodes.title: Similarity of regular polytopes

nodes.summary: Two convex polytopes $P$ and $Q$ in $\mathbb{R}^n$ are similar when there are a real number $a > 0$ and an affine isometry $\varphi$ of $\mathbb{R}^n$ such that the underlying set of $Q$ is $\{a\,\varphi(x) : x \in P\}$.
nodes.title: Similar polytopes

nodes.summary: The underlying set of a convex polytope $P$ in $\mathbb{R}^n$ is the convex hull of its vertex set.
nodes.title: Underlying set of a convex polytope

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
